label: Casual Greetings
description: Friendly everyday greetings for friends, neighbors, and low-pressure small talk.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic friendly opening. 1. 'Привет' is the most common casual greeting. 2. 'Как дела?' is the standard follow-up question for everyday conversation. 3. This is the simplest reusable small-talk line in the deck.
Strategic focus: Friendly reply. 1. 'Всё хорошо' gives a short, positive answer. 2. 'А у тебя?' turns the question back naturally. 3. This is the most common shape of an easy back-and-forth greeting.

Strategic focus: Casual check-in. 1. 'Что нового?' is a very natural everyday question. 2. It works well with friends, classmates, and coworkers you already know. 3. The phrase trains a common conversational opener without extra grammar load.

Strategic focus: Warm social tone. 1. 'Рад' keeps the phrase personal and upbeat. 2. 'Тебя видеть' focuses on the person rather than the event. 3. This is a friendly line that sounds natural in face-to-face conversation.

Strategic focus: Colloquial check-in. 1. 'Как сам?' is a relaxed, very spoken way to ask how someone is doing. 2. The short shape makes it feel like real conversation rather than a textbook prompt. 3. This works best with people you know well.
